# BeBetter

BeBetter is a self-hosted habit tracking, task management, and social accountability application. Built with Vue 3, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

## Features
- Habit tracking with flexible scheduling
- Task management with one-time scheduling
- Social accountability (friends, challenges, buddies)
- Push notifications with Web Push protocol
- Contribution grid analytics
- Self-hosted with Docker

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Vue 3, Vite, TailwindCSS, Pinia
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Prisma ORM
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Deployment: Docker, Traefik

## Self-Hosting
BeBetter is designed to be self-hosted. See the GitHub repository for deployment instructions.
